tools.name: food-safety_search
tools.description: Search UK food businesses by name, location, postcode, or hygiene rating using the Food Standards Agency Food Hygiene Rating Scheme API. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/food-safety/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: food-safety_business
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific food business by its FSA FHRSID from the Food Standards Agency Food Hygiene Rating Scheme API. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/food-safety/business. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: food-safety_batch
tools.description: Retrieve details for multiple food businesses in a single batch request using the Food Standards Agency Food Hygiene Rating Scheme API. Price $0.15 USDC. POST /api/v1/food-safety/batch. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: food-safety_ratings
tools.description: Retrieve the list of available hygiene rating values and their descriptions from the Food Standards Agency Food Hygiene Rating Scheme API. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/food-safety/ratings. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: food-safety_authorities
tools.description: Retrieve the list of local authorities and their establishment counts from the Food Standards Agency Food Hygiene Rating Scheme API. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/food-safety/authorities. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "food-safety" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: food-safety_search, food-safety_business, food-safety_batch, food-safety_ratings, food-safety_authorities · Public sink: food-safety_search, food-safety_business, food-safety_batch, food-safety_ratings, food-safety_authorities · Destructive: food-safety_search, food-safety_business, food-safety_batch, food-safety_ratings, food-safety_authorities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: food-safety_search, food-safety_business, food-safety_batch, food-safety_ratings, food-safety_authorities · Public sink: food-safety_search, food-safety_business, food-safety_batch, food-safety_ratings, food-safety_authorities · Destructive: food-safety_search, food-safety_business, food-safety_batch, food-safety_ratings, food-safety_authorities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
